title: The Practice Question Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Questions organized by topic, difficulty, and learning objective. The Practice Question Database holds practice questions as structured records: the question text, topic, difficulty rank, the learning objective it tests, and a fully worked solution kept separate from the question so students can attempt before peeking. Difficulty is calibrated on a 1-15 teaching-ladder scale. The Signature side adds hint ladders: three escalating hints per question before the solution.
capabilities: Organize questions by topic, difficulty rank, and learning objective
Keep solutions separate from questions for genuine practice
Provide escalating hint ladders before revealing solutions
Generate mixed practice sets balanced across topics
Track which objectives each question covers for gap analysis
